methodology: Read Qur'an 11:36–40 against Genesis 6:14–22 and 7:1–16 in the Sefaria Hebrew/JPS presentation. Classifications limited to inspected passages; no critical-edition collation or manuscript verification. Distinguish common Flood episode from verse-specific parallels.

ayat.assessment: Revelation to Noah that no further members of his people will believe. Genesis 6:13 announces judgment but does not say no further converts will believe; no exact parallel established in inspected Genesis.

God commands Noah to build the ark under divine supervision; Genesis 6:14–16 commands ark construction with detailed materials and measurements, absent from this Qur'anic verse. Qur'an additionally forbids intercession for wrongdoers.

Noah's people mock him while he builds; Genesis 6:14–22 describes obedience and construction but does not narrate this exchange. Search securely dated earlier extra-biblical Noah traditions separately.
Noah warns mockers of humiliating and lasting punishment; no exact corresponding speech in checked Genesis ark-building narrative.

Ark boarding of pairs, family and believers at Flood onset has a substantial narrative correspondence with Genesis 7:1–16. Differences: Qur'an mentions the overflowing tannur and excludes decreed family members; Genesis names sons and their wives and describes fountains of the deep and floodgates of heaven. Tannur is not a Hebrew Genesis term.

staged_candidates.similarity: God instructs Noah to construct an ark before judgment
staged_candidates.difference: Genesis gives dimensions/materials; Qur'an emphasizes divine oversight and non-intercession
